# Juleflet

> Free printable templates for Danish woven paper Christmas hearts (julehjerter), with tools to design your own: an editor, a painter that finds the cuts for a picture, and a generator for figures and text. Danish at /, English under /en/.

## For AI agents

- [Making a woven heart](https://juleflet.dk/agents.md): how to design a new pattern, check that it can be cut and woven, improve it, and put it in the visitor's own collection ("Mine hjerter"). Can be saved as a skill file.

## Pages

- [Templates](https://juleflet.dk/en/): the gallery of hearts, each with a printable template and a film of the weaving
- [Design](https://juleflet.dk/en/design/): make a heart from a figure or a word
- [Editor](https://juleflet.dk/en/editor/): draw the cuts yourself
- [Paint](https://juleflet.dk/en/editor/paint/): paint the woven picture and let the site find the cuts
- [How to](https://juleflet.dk/en/how-to/): cutting and weaving, step by step
- [About](https://juleflet.dk/en/about/): the history of the craft and of the site

## Template files

A few templates are also plain PDF files (A4, the heart 80 mm wide), each linked from its heart's page; every other heart's PDF is made by the "Hent skabelon" button on its page.

- [Klassisk 3×3](https://juleflet.dk/skabelon/classic-3x3.pdf)
- [Stjerne](https://juleflet.dk/skabelon/stjerne.pdf)
- [JUL](https://juleflet.dk/skabelon/jul.pdf)
- [Nemt hjerte](https://juleflet.dk/skabelon/nemt-hjerte.pdf)

## Source

- [GitHub](https://github.com/thomasahle/julehjerte): the site's code, MIT licence
